intended_behavior: Modify the error handling logic so that if result.isError is True but result.content contains one or more contents with a 'text' attribute, then return that text (either a single string if one content or list of strings if multiple) instead of raising a ToolError. Only raise ToolError if isError is True and no content.text is found. This allows MCP server error messages to be returned for further processing instead of being lost to exceptions. Preserve existing behavior for non-error results and for error results with no textual content by raising ToolError.
